title: Two Questions
stamp: Answered the weather. Not the question.
next: Next: a trophy is not an audit.

scenes.text: Passenger asks: who decided it was out of our jurisdiction, and by when will you answer? Reply: “I’ve asked for it to be looked into.”
Months later: was the request to legal in writing? What date? To whom? Reply: the formal answer from December, repeated, plus one new question: where was the ticket bought?
He said: in Brazil. Then asked when and how we’d contacted the airline. In the messages on file, that one is still waiting.
